verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio is a free public resource with 50+ customizable forms and document generators, 'all free, no registration required.' Specific generators include a Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator, a German Incorporation Questionnaire and the tsc.orrick.com term sheet wizard. A community member reports using the docs to form their company without ever hiring Orrick, which corroborates use without being a client. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an NDA template and a SAFE generator, and a US incorporation document set named in first-party docs.
